import importlib.util, json, random, sys, time
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m', '/workspace/submission/main.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)

stats = []
orig = m.moore
def patched(n, trans, part, blocks):
    t0 = time.time(); r = orig(n, trans, part, blocks); t1 = time.time()
    stats.append(('moore', n, blocks, r[1], r[2], round(t1-t0, 3)))
    if not r[2]:
        t2 = time.time(); h = m.hopcroft(n, len(trans[0]), trans, r[0], r[1]); t3 = time.time()
        stats.append(('hopcroft', n, r[1], h[1], True, round(t3-t2, 3)))
        assert sorted(h[0]) == sorted(r[0]) or True
        # verify hopcroft result equals moore-continued result
        p, b = r[0], r[1]
        while True:
            p2, b2, done = orig(n, trans, p, b)
            if done: break
            p, b = p2, b2
        def classes(pp):
            d = {}
            for q, v in enumerate(pp): d.setdefault(v, []).append(q)
            return sorted(sorted(v) for v in d.values())
        assert classes(h[0]) == classes(p), 'hopcroft mismatch'
        stats.append(('moore-continued', n, b, b, True, '-'))
    return r
m.moore = patched

def run(req, tag):
    del stats[:]
    info = m.validate(json.loads(json.dumps(req)))
    t0 = time.time()
    try:
        out = m.compile_request(info)
        n = len(out['dfa']['accept'])
    except m.ComplexErr:
        print(tag, 'E_COMPLEXITY'); return
    print(tag, 'final states', n, 'total %.2fs' % (time.time()-t0), stats)

svcs = ['t%d' % i for i in range(7)] + ['a','b','c'] + ['u%d' % i for i in range(14)]
args = [{'op':'contains','path':['t%d' % i]} for i in range(7)] + \
       [{'op':'contains','path':['a']*16}, {'op':'contains','path':['b']*16},
        {'op':'contains','path':['c']*8}]
run({'services': svcs, 'rules': [{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'and','args':args}}],
     'queries': []}, 'heavy-and')

# same but with a drop rule that collapses much of the product
run({'services': svcs, 'rules': [
        {'action':'allow','when':{'op':'and','args':args}},
        {'action':'drop','when':{'op':'contains','path':['u0']}}],
     'queries': []}, 'heavy-and+drop')

# long distinguishing words with heavy merging: or of two long matches
run({'services': ['x','y'], 'rules': [
        {'action':'allow','when':{'op':'or','args':[
            {'op':'contains','path':['x']*16},
            {'op':'contains','path':['y']*16}]}}], 'queries': []}, 'or-two-runs')

rnd = random.Random(9)
for trial in range(6):
    sigma = rnd.randint(2,4)
    toks = ['s%d'%i for i in range(sigma)]
    atoms = []
    for op in ('match','startswith','endswith','contains'):
        L = rnd.randint(8,16)
        atoms.append({'op':op,'path':[rnd.choice(toks) for _ in range(L)]})
    req = {'services':toks,'rules':[{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'and','args':atoms}},
                                   {'action':'drop','when':rnd.choice(atoms)}],
           'queries':[]}
    try:
        run(req, 'mixed%d' % trial)
    except Exception as e:
